name: cyber_Folks S.A.
summary: cyber_Folks S.A. operates as an e-commerce technology company in Europe. It operates through cyber_Folks, Vercom, and e-commerce segments. The cyber_Folks segment provides various solutions supporting the development of enterprises' online presence, including hosting services; and registration, sale, and transfer of domain names, as well as tools for building, operating, and scaling online stores and websites. The Vercom segment offers multi-channel communication services comprising text, multimedia, voice, and video messaging delivered through SMS, e-mail, push notifications, OTT, and other forms of digital communication.
